draft_baseline.method: Original published draft projection, preserved from Git. Changes since draft can include subsequent model changes as well as results and ratings.

race_story.note: Pick changes are changes in expected final points, not an additive explanation of championship probability. Results, ratings, and model updates can all contribute.

games_to_watch.rooting_note: This one could go either way.

routes.condition: Iowa State wins its next game
routes.headline: Root for Iowa State.
routes.story: Todd gets a better shot if Iowa State wins its next game.
routes.why: Todd picked Iowa State to beat its preseason win target. Wins are good news for that pick.
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 49 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.narrative: Todd does not need style points from Iowa State. A messy win does the same job for this pick as a blowout. Survive first; look impressive later.
routes.banter: Todd has decades of Browns practice at accepting outcomes. If Iowa State makes this difficult, the group can test whether that famously unbothered calm covers college football too.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Todd has a stronger title case and a ready-made reason to remind everyone about this pick.

routes.rival_note: Bryan is pulling the other way on South Florida.

routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Todd has a stronger title case and Bryan will have been cheering against the very same results.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
